top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Collado del Condor's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.

Road-specific control matters at Gran Fondo Collado del Condor. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 76 miles.
Gran Fondo Collado del Condor's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At Gran Fondo Collado del Condor, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Collado del Condor. Train it until it feels boring.
76 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Collado del Condor. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Gran Fondo Collado del Condor. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Gran Fondo Collado del Condor's mixed terrain actually does to you.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Gran Fondo Collado del Condor's 76 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Gran Fondo Collado del Condor includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Gran Fondo Collado del Condor rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 76 miles of mixed terrain in Merida, Venezuela.
